```{r}
# Cargar librerías necesarias
library(rvest)
```

```{r}
# Función para extraer ubicación 
extract_location_safe <- function(page) {
  location <- NA
  
  tryCatch({
    # Método 1: Buscar enlaces con ghost-stories-countries.php
    country_links <- page %>%
      html_nodes("a[href*='ghost-stories-countries.php']") %>%
      html_attr("href")
    
    if (length(country_links) > 0) {
      # Extraer el código de país del primer enlace
      country_code <- str_extract(country_links[1], "country=([A-Z]{2})") %>%
        str_replace("country=", "")
      
      if (!is.na(country_code)) {
        # Diccionario simple de códigos principales
        codes <- c(
          "US" = "United States", "CA" = "Canada", "GB" = "United Kingdom", 
          "AU" = "Australia", "IN" = "India", "PH" = "Philippines", 
          "ZA" = "South Africa", "IE" = "Ireland", "NZ" = "New Zealand",
          "DE" = "Germany", "FR" = "France", "IT" = "Italy", "ES" = "Spain",
          "MX" = "Mexico", "BR" = "Brazil", "JP" = "Japan", "CN" = "China",
          "RU" = "Russia", "PL" = "Poland", "NL" = "Netherlands"
        )
        
        if (country_code %in% names(codes)) {
          location <- codes[country_code]
        } else {
          location <- country_code
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Método 2: Solo si el anterior falla, buscar texto "Country:"
    if (is.na(location)) {
      page_text <- page %>% html_text()
      country_match <- str_extract(page_text, "Country:\\s*([A-Za-z\\s]{2,25})")
      
      if (!is.na(country_match)) {
        location <- str_replace(country_match, "Country:\\s*", "") %>%
          str_trim() %>%
          str_to_title()
      }
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Si hay cualquier error, simplemente devolver NA
    location <- NA
  })
  
  return(location)
}

```

```{r}
parse_story <- function(url) {
  if (is.na(url)) return(NULL)
  cat("Analizando:", url, "\n")
  

  page <- try({
    session <- html_session(url, user_agent("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"))
    session
  }, silent = TRUE)
  
  if (inherits(page, "try-error")) {
    page <- try(read_html(url), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(page, "try-error")) {
      warning("Falló al leer: ", url)
      return(NULL)
    }
  } else {
    page <- try(read_html(page), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(page, "try-error")) {
      warning("Falló al leer: ", url)
      return(NULL)
    }
  }
  
 
  title <- page %>% html_node("h1") %>% html_text(trim = TRUE)
  
  body <- page %>%
    html_nodes("#story p") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\n\n")
  
  category <- page %>%
    html_nodes(xpath = "//a[contains(@href,'ghost-stories-categories.php')]") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE) %>%
    .[1]
  

  location <- extract_location_safe(page)
  
  if (is.na(title) | is.na(body)) return(NULL)
  
  data.frame(
    title = title,
    story = body,
    category = ifelse(length(category) > 0, category, NA),
    location = location,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


start_id <- 1
end_id <- 3000

stories_list <- list()
success_count <- 0
error_count <- 0

cat("=== INICIANDO SCRAPING ===\n")
cat("Objetivo: extraer", end_id, "historias\n\n")

for (i in start_id:end_id) {
  url <- paste0("https://www.yourghoststories.com/real-ghost-story.php?story=", i)
  story <- parse_story(url)
  
  if (!is.null(story)) {
    stories_list[[length(stories_list) + 1]] <- story
    success_count <- success_count + 1
  } else {
    error_count <- error_count + 1
  }
  
  # Mostrar progreso cada 50 historias
  if (i %% 50 == 0) {
    cat("Progreso:", i, "/", end_id, "| Exitosas:", success_count, "| Errores:", error_count, "\n")
  }
  
  gc()
  
  # Delay
  if (i < 350) {
    Sys.sleep(0.4)
  } else {
    Sys.sleep(0.7)
  }
}

if (length(stories_list) > 0) {
  stories_df <- do.call(rbind, stories_list)
  rownames(stories_df) <- NULL
  
  cat("\n=== RESULTADOS FINALES ===\n")
  cat("Total de historias guardadas:", nrow(stories_df), "\n")
  cat("Historias exitosas:", success_count, "\n")
  cat("Errores:", error_count, "\n")
  
  # Estadísticas de ubicación
  locations_found <- sum(!is.na(stories_df$location))
  cat("Historias con ubicación:", locations_found, "\n")
  cat("Tasa de éxito:", round(success_count/(success_count+error_count)*100, 2), "%\n")
  cat("Tasa de ubicación:", round(locations_found/nrow(stories_df)*100, 2), "%\n")
  
  # Mostrar ubicaciones encontradas si las hay
  if (locations_found > 0) {
    cat("\nUbicaciones encontradas:\n")
    location_table <- table(stories_df$location[!is.na(stories_df$location)])
    print(sort(location_table, decreasing = TRUE))
  }
  
  # Guardar resultado
  write.csv(stories_df, "ghost_stories_2000.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  cat("Archivo guardado como: ghost_stories_3000.csv\n")
  

  head(stories_df)
  
} else {
  cat("No se pudieron extraer historias\n")
}
```
